purpose: Localize accumulated inspiral trajectory and phase differences underlying the remaining fitted strong aligned-spin whole-waveform residual after source-backed flux placement.
public_frequency_method: Five-point centered derivative of public low-rate orbital phase, then linear crossing interpolation of time and state. Public phase is reported relative to the first frequency point.
native_frequency_method: Existing source-flux waveform trajectory frequency and state, linearly interpolated at the same frequency crossings. Exact waveform time/mode hashes must replay the frozen source-flux run.
mode_method: Compare the source-flux native raw pre-NQC amplitude and raw mode phase derivative on its fine trajectory with the previously frozen public raw-mode reconstruction at the same frequencies. The public mode mapping has known one-sample uncertainty; this check is contextual, not an exact decomposition of waveform L2.
